faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bharathidasan University Guest Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Guest Lecturer posts at Bharathidasan University is 03 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Guest Lecturer position at Bharathidasan University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Botany and a Post Graduate degree in a relevant discipline to be eligible for the Guest Lecturer role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Lecturer is Rs. 500 per hour, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Bharathidasan University Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Lecturer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Lecturer position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Bharathidasan University located?
faq.answer: Bharathidasan University is located in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 620024.

faq.question: Q9. What is the interview date for the Guest Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview for the Guest Lecturer recruitment is scheduled for 06 August 2024.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply online for this position?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the Bharathidasan University Guest Lecturer recruitment is strictly offline.
